sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:40931  CRL.P No. 11109 of 2023  ORDER Accused No.2 in Crime No.170/2023 registered by the K.R.Sagar Police Station, Mandya District for the offences punishable under Sections 304B, 498A r/w Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C seeking regular bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3.

On the basis of the complaint lodged by Shekar M, S/o Madegowda, FIR in Crime No.170/2023 was registered against Surya and three others for the offences punishable under Sections 304B,
498A r/w Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

In the FIR,
petitioner is arrayed as accused No.2.
In the complaint dated 10.08.2023, lodged by the father of deceased Darshini.S, it is averred that accused No.1- Surya, who is the son of the petitioner herein and Darshini were in love.

It is further averred that for the purpose of performing their marriage,
there was a demand for NC: 2023:KHC:40931 payment of dowry.
The complainant agreed and sought for arranging the same.
In the meanwhile, the son of petitioner and Darshini had got married without informing anybody.
Thereafter, Darshini was residing with Surya in her matrimonial house.
In the complaint, it is averred that accused persons were ill treating and torturing Darshini, in furtherance of their demand for dowry.
On 10.08.2023, complainant was informed over phone that his daughter Darshini had committed suicide by hanging herself and her body was taken to K.R.Hospital.
Immediately, complainant and his family members went to the Hospital.
When they tried to enquire with accused No.1 - Surya, he allegedly tried to assault the complainant and his family members, but when the people in the hospital gathered there, he allegedly ran away.

In this background, the complainant had approached the police and lodged a complaint, which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime No.170/2023.
4.
During the course of investigation of the case, petitioner was arrested on 12.08.2023.
His bail application NC: 2023:KHC:40931 filed before the III Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Mandya in Crl. Misc. No.5299/2023 was dismissed on 19.10.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition submits that the petitioner is the father of accused No.1.
Accused No.3, who is the wife of the petitioner has been granted regular bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.8619/2023.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent-State has opposed the bail petition.

7. The materials on record would go to show that marriage of accused No.1 with deceased Darshini,
who is the daughter of the complainant was a love marriage and they had married without informing their parents and relatives.

Therefore, a serious doubt arises with regard to the allegations made in the complaint about demand for payment of dowry for the purpose of performing the NC:
2023:KHC:40931 marriage.
Considering the above said aspect of the matter, this Court has enlarged accused No.3 on regular bail in Crl.P.No.8619/2023 disposed of on 05.10.2023.
Therefore, I am of the view that even the petitioner is entitled for the relief sought for by him.
8. Accordingly, petition is allowed.
